content.text: Bangkong maw atuengnaw heh Athakasaipounge ni
a hro hoeh vaw,
ama kapanueknaw ni
amamae ahnin hah a hmu thai awh hoeh vaw.
Tangawn ni khori hah a puen awh.
Saringnaw hah a lawp awh teh ama hanelah a paca awh.
Naranaw e la hah a pâlei pouh awh teh,
lahmai e maitotan hah lawkkamnae lah a pangen pouh awh.
Tami kavoutthoupnaw hah lamthung a phen sak awh.
Ram thung e karoedengnaw hah pâkhueng teh, kâhro hoi ao awh.
Thingyeiyawn ramke dawk e la patetlah,
rawca tawng hanelah, thaw tawk han lah a cei awh.
Amamouh hoi a canaw hanelah ram ni ca hane rawca a tâco sak.
Law dawk e saringnaw e rawca hah a pâkhueng teh,
tamikathoutnaw e misurpaw hah a pâtung awh.
Khohna e awm laipalah karum khodai caici lah a i awh.
Pâding nah kâkhu hane tawn awh hoeh.
Mon dawk kho ka rak e ni cupkâkasu lah a pâsin teh,
a phui nahanelah lungsongpui a kângue awh.
A na pa kaawm hoeh e camo teh, a manu e sanu hoi a pâphei sak.
Karoedengnaw hah amamae hno hah a pâhung sak.
Karoedengnaw, hah caici lah ao sak awh.
A von kahlamnaw koe e cabong hah a la pouh awh.
Ayânaw im vah satui hah a kuen awh teh,
misurpaw katin nalaihoi tui a kahran awh.
Khopui thung vah hmenghmeng a due awh teh,
a hramki awh. Hmâ a ca awh teh, hringnae hah a kaw awh.
Hateiteh, Cathut ni a ratoum awh e hah pato hoeh.
Angnae hah taranlahoi tarankathawnaw hah ao.
A lamthung hah panuek awh hoeh teh,
angnae lamthung hah ngai awh hoeh.
Tamikathetnaw ni angnae dawk hoi a thaw awh teh,
karoedengnaw hoi kavoutthoupnaw hah a thei awh.
Karum e tami tamru patetlah ao awh.
Ayâ yu yonkhai hane mit ni khohmo a ngaihawi.
Minhmai a hro teh, apini na hmawt mahoeh telah a pouk.
Kanîthun lah mitnout a ta e im hah karum lah a muk awh teh,
angnae hah panuek awh hoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh hanelah teh,
amom hah duenae tâhlip patetlah ao.
Tami ni panuek awh boipawiteh,
takikatho poung e duenae tâhlip doeh ati awh han.
Tui hoi karanglah pâyo sak lah ao awh han.
Talai dawkvah coe hane thoebo lah ao han.
Hatdawkvah, apihai misur takha lamthung koe lah kamlang mahoeh.
Kawmpoi khumbei kâan e ni tadamtui a kamyawt sak.
Hot patetvanlah, phuen ni yonnae ka sak e hah a payawp awh.
Camo im ni a pahnim awh vaiteh,
tangraet ni katuipoung lah a ca awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, cakaroe e hah a rektap teh,
lahmainu hanelah hnokahawi lah awmhoeh.
Hateiteh, Cathut ni athaonae hoi,
tami athakaawme taminaw e lamthung hah a raphoe pouh.
Hring hane kamcenglah a panue hoeh nakunghai, Ama ni a thaw sak.
A kângue hane a poe teh, hawvah a kâhat sak.
A mit teh ahnimae lamthung dawk ao.
Vai touh hoi tawm lah ao teh, hat hnukkhu hoi a kahma awh.
Rahnoum sak la ao teh, ayânaw patetvanlah a kâhmo van han. Cavui patetlah a ke awh.
Hot patetlah awm hoeh pawiteh,
apini maw na laithoe a tithai han.
Ka dei e heh bang hoeh e lah
ka coung sak thai e na o awh maw telah a ti.
